documents.text: Python is a programming language used for software development, scripting, and automation.
Automation scripts reduce repetitive manual work by executing routine tasks consistently.
The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest ocean on Earth.
Machine learning uses data to train models that make predictions and identify patterns.
Data analysis involves examining and interpreting information to discover trends, relationships, and useful insights.
Weather forecasts estimate rainfall, temperature, wind, and sunshine.
Climate describes long-term weather patterns, including typical rainfall and temperature across a region.
Security logs record authentication attempts, failed logins, and suspicious activity.
Audit trails help investigators review user actions, access events, and changes made within a system.
Password policies define requirements for password length, complexity, expiration, and account protection.
